n: Rob-Bot The Computational Thinking Card Game
t: A printable matching card game linked to computational thinking skills.
steps: Find the Rob-Bot card game on Tes from Robbot Resources.
Check the current price in your region and buy the PDF.
Print the 57 cards and cut them apart.
Read the rules for two to four players.
Play one round with a colleague.
Teach students the rules in small groups.
